name: beyond09_layer_three_state
goal: Close BEYOND-9 (SC-C2): the per-layer three-state control (Print only / Both / Screen only) must be visible per layer, respected by the print path, and restored across a reload — each of the three measured, not reasoned about
card: [UX Gap] SC-C2: Per-layer three-state control (Print Only / Screen Only / Both) missing — test shows basic enable/disable only
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 Layer panel shows three-state selector per layer (Print Only / Screen Only / Both)
AC-2 Print preview respects Print Only / Screen Only states correctly
AC-3 Settings persist three-state selection across reloads
AC-4 E2E test layer_print_visibility.spec.js extended to cover all three states
AC-5 Gate G-PIX-OVERFLOW and G-PERSIST pass for the new states
stale_card_premises: The card says the mechanism does not exist; commit ac3c72f (track ux_quick_wins_20261025, 2026-10-26) shipped it as that track's AC-1 — js/dom/layer_manager.js LAYER_MODES/layerModeOf/setLayerMode/syncModeStrip, js/print_styles.js print-only undo, js/ui_theme.js strip theme.

The card's 'Quick win: YES — UI addition only' is half true: the UI addition was cheap but not UI-only (a new !important print rule was required), while the storage path did already carry both per-layer flags unchanged.
gaps_found_and_closed: AC-3 was a REAL product gap: a layer-panel edit never persisted itself (only drag/nudge/property commits did), so a picked mode was discarded by a reload. Fixed by LayerManager.requestLayerPersist() called from the four layer-flag writers.

AC-2 was a COVERAGE gap, not a product gap: it was asserted against the injected stylesheet text instead of the rendered print media. Now measured with page.emulateMedia({media:'print'}) + getComputedStyle.
AC-1 was a COVERAGE gap: only the sections layer group was ever inspected. Now every group is, and the shapes group's own strip is driven.

verification_vehicles.unit: npm test (smoke + mocha test/unit test/e2e test/manifest.test.js)

evidence.e2e_certification_pass: 4 passing / 0 failing — same spec, --grep "BEYOND-9 certification pass"
evidence.red_e2e: first run of the new cases: 3 passing / 1 failing — AC-3 'the reloaded page restores Print only' returned ['both']
evidence.unit_composite_after: 2253 passing / 2 failing — the same 2 pre-existing input_budget_alignment failures, proved pre-existing by stashing the product change
evidence.regression_e2e: print_per_layer.spec.js 7/7 passing; byok_settings_persistence_types.spec.js 5/5 passing in its own process
evidence.lint: npm run lint clean (35 checks passed, 0 violations; SCRIPTS HYGIENE OK)
evidence.guard: HOUSEKEEPING GUARD OK — no issues/tracks debt; deliberation ADMITTED

known_non_blockers_recorded: Two e2e spec files in ONE mocha process break the harness's reinject() after page.reload() (all 5 reload cases in byok_settings_persistence_types fail; each file alone passes). The project's scripts run one spec per process.
input_budget_alignment.test.js is red on a clean tree (2 failing) — model window / prompt budget arithmetic, unrelated to this track.
The fourth corner of the two-flag space (hidden on screen AND skipped on print) lights no strip segment by design; pinned by a case, not given a fourth mode.
